rows.practice: specifies hard materials and planting for landscape proposals and presents them through models, hand drawing and digital tools such as GIS and CAD to expert and lay audiences
rows.knowledge: the structural and environmental performance of materials and their broad cost, plus the ecosystem around a project that proposals must conserve and balance
rows.identity: an emerging landscape professional who forms an informed stance, keeps to professional codes of conduct and respects the moral, social and ecological questions the work raises

rows.practice: applies landscape survey, design and planning skills fluently with original approaches, exceptional initiative and strong problem-solving, taking personal responsibility for projects and leading others
rows.knowledge: strong and consistently shown knowledge of landscape theory, materials, ecology and practice that meets every course outcome and feeds insightful, creative proposals
rows.identity: a landscape professional with clear ethical and professional awareness who reflects critically and independently on own work and takes the lead with growing autonomy

rows.practice: draws concepts and ideas together and connects them to landscape practice, using alternative methods to find information and to collect and analyse data with rigour
rows.knowledge: a sound grasp of the roles, duties and working methods of landscape professionals and the values and ethics that govern practice, set beside alternative research methods
rows.identity: a questioning and independent landscape architect on the accredited route to chartership who reflects critically, acts on own judgement and brings originality and insight to practice

tierReadings.note: The typical and excellent standards restate the threshold in general terms (more originality, autonomy, leadership), so e2 carries the threshold's landscape specifics forward at that higher pitch.

digest.definition: Both a long-standing profession and an academic subject, grounded in research across the arts, humanities and the physical, natural, environmental and social sciences, with analogue and digital representation as tools of analysis and communication
distinctiveFeatures: Both a long-standing profession and an academic subject, grounded in research across the arts, humanities and the physical, natural, environmental and social sciences, with analogue and digital representation as tools of analysis and communication
It asks what landscape means, how it forms and changes, how people use it, and how to conserve, restore and manage existing landscapes and create sustainable, resilient, inclusive ones for the future
It works on landscapes of every kind and scale, urban, rural and in between, across assessment, planning, design, management and conservation, and feeds national policy
A place-focused discipline linking human and natural systems, sensitive to natural systems, cultural identity and heritage, and the pull between global and local decisions
It sees itself as the profession best placed to lead green infrastructure, making places rich in nature, healthy, thriving, well drained and climate positive
Its definition of landscape comes from the European Landscape Convention, which the UK has signed; the IFLA/UNESCO charter defines the landscape architect's role
Teaching centres on the design studio and on projects of rising scale and complexity that simulate practice, from site survey to specification
The professional route runs through LI accreditation and an accredited master's to chartered status

themesInSubject.inThisSubject: the LI's competencies on equality, diversity and inclusivity, its built-environment memorandum and landscape-sector declaration; inclusive curricula and EDI literacy for students; professional conduct with regard to equity, diversity and inclusion and inclusive group work (D1, 1.15, 1.18, 1.23, 1.24; 4.4)

the LI competency on inclusive environments; access to studios, resources and fieldwork and alternative forms of teaching and assessment; communication that reaches people with diverse needs; the LI broadening entry routes (D1, 1.15, 1.25, 2.23; 4.4)

named sustainability and education for sustainability: climate, resilience, systems thinking on biodiversity and natural capital, policy, regenerative design, case studies and materiality; creativity in a sustainable context and the sustainability of materials (D1, 1.15, 1.26; 4.4)

implicit in the LI competencies (practice types, business, contracts, indemnity); courses may offer professional networks, industry standards, ethical practice and CPD; course design reflecting industry and employability (D1, 1.16, 1.27, 2.10; 4.4)

generative AI challenges academic integrity and the design process, so openness and critical reflection are central; AI appears among the digital tools students use and in preparing communication (D1, 3.14; 4.4)

statements.about: physical access to resources and fieldwork
statements.paraphrase: Courses should consider how inclusive, fair design opens physical access to resources and facilities, fieldwork among them.

forPractitioner.text: Consider how your course should open physical access to its resources and facilities, fieldwork included, through inclusive design in every part of delivery.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on the course; the student meets its effect, not a standard to reach

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.about: academic access through alternative forms of delivery
statements.paraphrase: Courses should consider how inclusive design opens academic access, offering other forms of teaching, learning, assessment or feedback where they suit.

forPractitioner.text: Consider how your course should open academic access, by offering alternative ways of teaching, learning, assessing and giving feedback where these fit.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on the course; the student meets its effect, not a standard to reach

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject, through course content
statements.about: values and actions for sustainability and the UN goals
statements.paraphrase: Course content will let students show they understand values and actions for sustainability that change society and lead to regenerative futures, as the UN goals illustrate.

forPractitioner.text: Course content will give students chances to show they understand sustainability values and actions that change society towards regenerative futures, with the UN goals as illustration.

forBeneficiary.text: You will have chances to show you understand the values and actions that move society towards a regenerative, sustainable future, using the UN goals as examples.

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject, through course content
statements.about: systems thinking: biodiversity and natural capital
statements.paraphrase: Course content will let students show they understand systems thinking centred on biodiversity, natural systems, natural capital and the ecosystem services that flow from them, at several scales.

forPractitioner.text: Course content will give students chances to show systems thinking about biodiversity, natural capital and ecosystem services, and how people interact with them at different scales.

forBeneficiary.text: You will have chances to show you can think in systems about biodiversity, natural capital and the services ecosystems give us, at different scales.

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject, through course content
statements.about: climate change: causes, effects, mitigation and adaptation
statements.paraphrase: Course content will let students show they understand the causes and effects of climate change and see chances for mitigation, adaptation and resilience.

forPractitioner.text: Course content will give students chances to show they understand climate change and can spot openings for mitigation, adaptation and resilience.

forBeneficiary.text: You will have chances to show you understand what causes climate change, what it does, and where design can reduce it or help places adapt.

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject, through course content
statements.about: legislation and policy at many levels
statements.paraphrase: Course content will let students show they understand international, national and local law and past, current and emerging policy across levels and subjects.

forPractitioner.text: Course content will give students chances to show they understand law at international, national and local level and policy past, present and emerging.

forBeneficiary.text: You will have chances to show you understand the law and policy, from global to local, that shape sustainable landscape work.

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject, through course content
statements.about: design for adaptation, resilience and regeneration
statements.paraphrase: Course content will let students show they understand design that helps communities and landscapes adapt, become resilient and regenerate.

forPractitioner.text: Course content will give students chances to show they understand design that helps communities and landscapes adapt, become resilient and regenerate.

forBeneficiary.text: You will have chances to show you understand how design can help communities and landscapes adapt, recover and renew.

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject, through course content
statements.about: case studies, best practice and live projects
statements.paraphrase: Course content will let students show understanding through case studies and good practice across scales and kinds of development, with live projects where possible.

forPractitioner.text: Course content will give students chances to show understanding through case studies and good practice at many scales, and live projects that face uncertainty where possible.

forBeneficiary.text: You will have chances to show what you understand through case studies, good practice and, where possible, live projects that imagine sustainable futures.

headingPath: Context and purposes of a Landscape Architecture degree

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject, through course content
statements.paraphrase: Course content will let students show they understand the materials they may specify, from extracting raw materials to disposing of waste.

forPractitioner.text: Course content will give students chances to show they understand materiality in the palettes they may specify, including extraction and waste.

forBeneficiary.text: You will have chances to show you understand where the materials you might specify come from and what happens to them as waste.

headingPath: Distinctive features of Landscape Architecture courses

statements.appliesTo: courses seeking or holding LI accreditation
statements.about: mapping accredited courses to the LI competency framework
statements.paraphrase: Each course will set its own identity and focus; accredited courses must map themselves to the LI competency framework to show where knowledge requirements are met.

forPractitioner.text: Your course sets its own focus (design, planning, management or ecology); if it is accredited it must map to the LI competency framework, showing where each knowledge requirement is met.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a requirement on accredited courses, set by the professional body

headingPath: Distinctive features of Landscape Architecture courses

statements.about: progression through the levels to the threshold
statements.paraphrase: Across an honours degree students move up level by level; each level is expected to build towards meeting every threshold skill, usually through credit for all learning and assessment.

forPractitioner.text: Plan each level so it builds towards all the threshold skills, with credit for the full range of learning and assessment; a second or above usually fits a graduate for postgraduate study.

forBeneficiary.text: As you move through each year, what you learn and do should build towards the full set of threshold skills; a second-class result or better usually prepares you for postgraduate study.

headingPath: Distinctive features of Landscape Architecture courses

statements.about: joint honours: core skills plus those of the other subject
statements.paraphrase: Students on joint or combined honours will reach core elements of the subject and generic skills and add others from their other subject.

forPractitioner.text: Joint or combined honours students will reach core elements of the specific and generic skills and add skills from their other subject.

forBeneficiary.text: If you study the subject with another, you will reach the core skills and add others from your second subject, with room to explore where they meet.

headingPath: Distinctive features of Landscape Architecture courses

statements.appliesTo: anyone starting the LI Pathway to Chartership
statements.about: the accredited master's for the chartership route
statements.paraphrase: Starting the formal route to chartered status must begin from a master's the LI accredits, carrying 180 credits or more at level 7.

forPractitioner.text: Tell students that the Pathway to Chartership must begin from an LI-accredited master's of at least 180 credits at level 7.

forBeneficiary.text: If you want to become a chartered landscape architect, you must first complete a master's the professional body accredits, worth 180 credits or more at level 7.

headingPath: Distinctive features of Landscape Architecture courses

statements.paraphrase: Prospective students should know funding varies with length, mode and country of study, and are advised to talk to the funding body and the institution first.

forPractitioner.text: Prospective students should be told that funding differs by duration, mode and nation, and pointed to the funding body and the institution before they commit.

forBeneficiary.text: Before you commit, you should know that funding depends on how long, how and where you study; talk to the funding body and the university first.

headingPath: Distinctive features of Landscape Architecture courses

statements.paraphrase: Providers will use external reviewers in periodic review to bring an outside view and make sure threshold standards are met and content fits the subject.

forPractitioner.text: In periodic review your institution will bring in external reviewers for an outside view, checking that threshold standards are met and content suits the subject.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on the provider in quality review

statements.about: a range of teaching techniques and the design studio
statements.paraphrase: All courses will use a range of teaching methods; the subject is marked by a studio-based, shared learning culture with projects of rising scale and complexity.

forPractitioner.text: Your course will use varied teaching methods, from lectures to design charettes, within a studio-based culture where projects grow in scale and complexity.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on the course in how it teaches

statements.appliesTo: students at every level of study
statements.about: formative and summative assessment at all levels

forPractitioner.text: At every level your course will give students both formative and summative assessment.

forBeneficiary.text: At every stage you will have both practice assessment with feedback and assessment that counts towards your marks.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can analyse information and draw its results together into a balanced case.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can analyse information and combine what they find into balanced arguments.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to analyse information and pull the results together into a fair, balanced argument.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show sound decision-making where situations are complex and hard to predict.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show they make decisions in complex, unpredictable settings.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to show that you can make decisions when a situation is complex and hard to predict.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: critical thinking towards a professional position
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can think critically to reach an informed stance of their own as an emerging landscape professional.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can use critical thinking to form their own informed position as future landscape professionals.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to think critically and reach your own informed view as someone entering the landscape profession.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can see a landscape as different stakeholders see it and build their needs into proposals.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can view landscapes through different stakeholders' eyes and fold their needs into proposals.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to see a landscape as the different people with a stake in it see it, and build their needs into your proposals.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: competing theories and priorities in judgement
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can understand and make room for rival theories and priorities so that judgements and proposals rest on good evidence.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates understand and allow for competing theories and priorities, so their judgements and proposals are well evidenced.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to understand rival theories and priorities and take them into account so your judgements rest on good evidence.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can assess alternative proposals with suitable tools and techniques.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can evaluate alternative proposals with fitting tools and techniques.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to compare and judge different proposals using the right tools and techniques.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can draft and read project briefs, setting suitable aims and objectives for known and new problems at varied scales.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can write and interpret project briefs, setting aims and objectives for familiar and new problems at many scales.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to write and read project briefs, setting sensible aims and objectives for problems old and new, small and large.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: from theory to policies, plans and interventions
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can pick the theory, concepts, principles and techniques that produce fitting policies, strategies, plans or interventions across scales of space and time.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can find the relevant theory and techniques and turn them into policies, strategies, plans or interventions at varied spatial and time scales.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to choose the theory and techniques that lead to good policies, strategies, plans or practical changes, at scales of space and time.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: researching and applying knowledge to problems
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can find, research and use knowledge on known and new problems at a range of scales.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify and research what they need to know and apply it to familiar and new problems of varied scale.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to work out what you need to know, research it and use it on familiar and new problems of any size.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can grasp and reflect on the ecosystem around a landscape project and frame proposals that conserve and balance it.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates appreciate and reflect on a project's ecosystem context and can frame proposals that conserve it and keep it in balance.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to understand and reflect on the ecosystem your project sits in, and design proposals that protect it and keep it in balance.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show creativity and new ideas within a sustainable frame.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show creativity and innovation in a sustainable context.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to show creative, new thinking that also respects sustainability.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can plan and conduct research, assess its results and reach sound conclusions.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can plan and carry out research, evaluate the outcomes and draw valid conclusions.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to plan and carry out research, judge what it shows and reach sound conclusions.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can work with secondary research sources, finding suitable academic literature and citing it by standard conventions.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can use secondary sources, find suitable academic literature and reference it to standard conventions.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to find and use published research and academic reading, and reference it properly.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: where ethical, legal or data issues arise
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can understand where questions of ethics, law or data protection may come up.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates understand where questions of ethics, law or data protection may arise in their work.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to tell where ethical, legal or data protection questions may come up in your work.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can understand what intellectual property is and how it affects creative design settings.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates understand the role and effect of intellectual property in creative design work.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to understand how intellectual property works in design and how it affects your work and others'.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can find, analyse and critique fitting precedents.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify, analyse and critique suitable precedent studies.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to find good precedents, analyse them and judge what they do well or badly.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can choose and specify suitable hard materials and planting for a range of proposals.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify and specify suitable hard materials and vegetation for varied proposals.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to choose and specify the right hard materials and plants for different proposals.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can understand how materials perform structurally and environmentally, and the broad cost of specifying them.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates understand the structural, performance and sustainability qualities of materials and the broad financial effects of specifying them.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to understand how materials perform, how sustainable they are and roughly what specifying them costs.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can identify suitable geomatic information: gathering, modelling and analysing data tied to location.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify suitable geomatic information, that is acquiring, modelling and analysing spatially referenced data.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to identify the right spatial data for a task and know how it is gathered, modelled and analysed.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can find and gather suitable sources of evidence and choose samples well.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify and collate suitable evidence and select samples effectively.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to find and gather the right evidence and choose your samples sensibly.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can choose and use fitting qualitative or quantitative techniques to analyse information.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify and apply suitable qualitative or quantitative analysis techniques.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to choose and use the right qualitative or numerical methods to analyse information.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: precision in recording and analysing data
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show due precision when identifying, recording and critically analysing data from field, laboratory or secondary sources.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show suitable precision in identifying, recording and critically analysing data from field, lab or secondary sources.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to record and analyse data from the field, the lab or published sources with the care and accuracy the task needs.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: handling and presenting data with software
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can prepare, process, interpret and present data with suitable techniques and software.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can prepare, process, interpret and present data using fitting techniques and software.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to prepare, process, interpret and present data using the right techniques and software.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can solve numerical problems with computer-based and other methods.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can solve numerical problems using computers and other techniques.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to solve number problems, with a computer or by other means.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can find, analyse and present cost information and draw on it in decisions matched to the scale of the proposals.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can find, analyse and present financial data and draw on it in decisions fitted to the nature and scale of proposals.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to find, analyse and present cost information and use it in decisions that suit the size of the proposal.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: safe desk, field and studio investigations
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can design, plan and carry out desk, field and studio investigations responsibly, sensitively and safely.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can design, plan and carry out investigations at the desk, in the field and in the studio, responsibly, sensitively and safely.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to design, plan and carry out desk, field and studio investigations in a careful, responsible and safe way.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: access rights, health and safety, research ethics
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can understand and keep to access rights and health and safety rules, with ethical care in research, with people and in the environment.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates understand and comply with rights of access and health and safety requirements, including ethics in research, with people and in the environment.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to understand and follow rules on access to land and on health and safety, and act ethically when working with people and places.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: scale and proportion in design or management
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show clear, fitting use of scale and proportion in designing or managing landscapes.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show a clear, suitable use of scale and proportion in landscape design or management.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to use scale and proportion clearly and well when you design or manage a landscape.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: models, hand drawing and graphics to present
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, in design areas, can use model-making, hand drawing and other graphic skills to show proposals to expert and lay audiences.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, in design subject areas, graduates can apply model-making, hand drawing and other graphic skills to put proposals before expert and lay audiences.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to in design work, use models, hand drawing and other graphics to show your proposals to experts and the public.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can work well alone, showing initiative, managing self, time and tasks, and reflecting.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can work effectively on their own, showing initiative, managing themselves, their time and their tasks, and reflecting.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to work well on your own, using initiative, managing your time and tasks and reflecting on how it went.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can name personal goals and responsibilities.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify their individual goals and responsibilities.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to set out your own goals and what you are responsible for.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can set realistic targets and act as allocated roles and responsibilities require.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can set realistic targets and perform as their allocated roles and responsibilities need.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to set realistic targets and do what your role in a team asks of you.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can reflect on and judge their own performance.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can reflect on and evaluate their own performance.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to look back on your own work and judge how well you did.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: adaptable approach to study and work
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can build an adaptable, flexible way of studying and working.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can develop an adaptable, flexible approach to study and work.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to adapt how you study and work when things change.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can build good time management and organisation, planning and carrying out a workload.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can develop effective time management and organisation, including planning and executing a workload.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to manage your time and organise your workload from plan to finish.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: professional competence and conduct, with EDI
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show the competence, behaviour and attitude the profession needs, with regard to equity, diversity and inclusion.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show the competence, behaviour and attitude the profession requires, with attention to equity, diversity and inclusion.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to show the skills, conduct and attitude the profession expects, including fairness and respect for everyone.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can recognise, respect and keep within fitting professional codes of conduct.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can recognise, respect and work within suitable professional codes of conduct.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to know, respect and work within the codes of conduct of the profession.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: moral, ethical, ecological and social issues
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can recognise and respect the moral, ethical, social and ecological questions the subject raises.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can recognise and respect the ethical, moral, social and ecological issues of the subject.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to see and respect the moral, ethical, ecological and social questions landscape work raises.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: generic skills for employability and CPD
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can build and show the generic skills needed to gain new competences for work, career growth and continuing professional development.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can develop and display generic skills to gain new competencies for employability, career progression and CPD.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to build and show the general skills you need to keep learning for work, career and professional development.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can choose and use hardware and software suited to the scale of the work to communicate proposals well to different audiences.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify and apply hardware and software fitted to the scale of work to communicate proposals to varied audiences.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to choose and use the right hardware and software for the job to share your proposals with different audiences.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can use the internet and social media fittingly, to communicate and to find information.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can use the internet and social media appropriately for communication and as an information source.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to use the internet and social media sensibly to communicate and find information.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show awareness of new technologies and of good, fitting ways to put them to use.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates are aware of emerging technologies and of effective, suitable ways to implement them.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to keep aware of new technologies and how to use them well.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: digital tools across survey, analysis and design
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can use suitable technology lawfully and well at each stage of survey, analysis and design, from CAD, GIS and BIM to drones, AI and spatial computing.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can apply suitable technology legally and appropriately across survey, analysis and design: CAD, visualisation, GIS, BIM, fabrication, AI, AR and VR, drones and apps among them.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to use the right digital tools legally and well through survey, analysis and design, such as CAD, GIS, BIM, 3D printing, AI, drones and survey apps.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can find and involve the many different stakeholders at the right stages of a project to test and shape research and proposals.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can identify and engage diverse stakeholders at suitable project stages to test and inform research and proposals.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to find and involve the different people with a stake in a project at the right moments, to test and shape your ideas.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: choosing communication methods for the audience
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can understand, choose and use approaches, tools and techniques that suit the audience and the material.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can understand, select and apply approaches, tools and techniques suited to the audience and the material.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to choose and use ways of communicating that suit both the audience and what you are showing.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can make sure communication is inclusive and accessible to as many people as possible, above all where stakeholders include minorities or people with varied needs.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can make communication inclusive and accessible to as wide a range of people as possible, particularly minority groups and those with diverse needs.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to make your communication inclusive and accessible to as many people as possible, especially those often left out.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can communicate clearly, briefly, confidently and fittingly to varied audiences in writing, speech and graphics, including physical and digital models.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can communicate clearly, concisely, confidently and appropriately to varied audiences in written, spoken and graphic forms, including models and visual media.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to communicate clearly, briefly and confidently in writing, speech, drawings and models to different audiences.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: accuracy and the limits of illustrative graphics
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can communicate accurately where possible and, where not, as with illustrative graphics, be open about the limits of the output.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can communicate accurately where they can, and where they cannot (as with illustrative graphics) make the limits of the output clear.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to be accurate where you can, and where an image is only illustrative, say so clearly.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.about: AI and emerging tools in communication
statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can try out and make use of new digital tools such as AI in preparing communication and presentations, while checking the outputs are fit and accurate.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can explore and use emerging digital tools such as AI to prepare communication and presentations, ensuring the outputs are appropriate and accurate.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to try new digital tools such as AI when preparing material, and check that what they produce is accurate and fit to use.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can help confidently and well to set a group's aims, objectives and roles.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can contribute confidently and effectively to setting group aims, objectives and roles.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to help your group agree its aims and who does what, with confidence.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can take part constructively and sensitively in group discussion, weighing and respecting others' views, especially those of people with varied life experience.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can contribute constructively and sensitively to group discussion, considering and respecting others' views, particularly from diverse life experiences.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to take part in group discussions constructively and with care, listening to and respecting views unlike your own.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can bring knowledge, critical thought and understanding to multidisciplinary problems and offer complete, joined-up solutions.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can apply knowledge and critical thinking to multidisciplinary problems and offer comprehensive, holistic solutions.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to bring what you know and think to problems that cross disciplines, and offer joined-up answers.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can contribute well to a group's outputs, such as reports and presentations.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can contribute effectively to group outputs, including reports and presentations.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to play your full part in producing a group's reports and presentations.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show the ability to lead a group across a range of projects.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show they can lead a group in a range of projects.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to lead a group on different kinds of project.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show the ability to be led as a group member across a range of projects.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show they can work under another's lead in a group across varied projects.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to work well under someone else's lead in a group.

headingPath: Threshold level: Subject knowledge, understanding and skills

statements.paraphrase: At threshold, can show awareness of the interdisciplinary character and processes of community engagement and consultation.

forPractitioner.text: At threshold, graduates can show awareness of the interdisciplinary nature and processes of community engagement and consultation.

forBeneficiary.text: To reach the threshold, you will be able to show you understand how community engagement and consultation work and who takes part in them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you use the threshold knowledge and skills with more critical reflection and take more responsibility for your own work.

statements.paraphrase: At the excellent standard, has met every required course outcome and shown strong knowledge, understanding and cognitive, practical and transferable skills.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you have met every outcome your course sets and shown strong knowledge and skills across the board.
